# Starlog P2: Public Beta (real AI readings, no payments) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax.

**Goal:** Ship `https://starlog.yeolmaeapps.kr` today as a public beta: tarot and saju readings are generated by Claude from server-fixed cards / server-computed charts, free within a daily quota, stored on the device; payments, login and server persistence come later (Toss approval pending).

**Architecture:** Stateless Next.js 16 route handlers on Vercel. Tarot draws are fixed server-side and handed to the client as an HMAC-signed draw token, so the client cannot choose cards. Generation calls Claude (`@anthropic-ai/sdk`, model `claude-opus-5-5`, structured JSON output, server-side refusal fallback) through a provider interface with a deterministic mock provider for tests and key-less dev. A free teaser is generated at the result step; the full reading is generated only when the user spends a daily beta unlock (signed-cookie quota + per-IP limiter). Generated chapters live in the browser (localStorage). Legal pages disclose AI generation and the overseas transfer to Anthropic.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16.3.7 / React 19.3 (existing), `@anthropic-ai/sdk` 0.129.0, `zod` 4.6.5 (schema + validation), Node `crypto` (HMAC), Vitest, Playwright.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-saju-tarot-story-app-design.md` (sections 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 15). Quality sources: `docs/research/tarot-reading-quality.md` (rubric, pipeline), `docs/research/saju-reading-quality.md` (FactSet contract, rule tiers, rubric), `docs/research/user-review-insights.md` (Top-10 rules), gold samples `content/samples/*.json`, card KB `content/kb/cards/*.json` (written in parallel; schema in `content/kb/README.md`). Claude API reference: the `claude-api` skill files under `C:\Users\최용우\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\bundled-skills\2.1.284\44a9f6569e0f1372029ffd844ecd1b6b\claude-api\` — read `typescript/claude-api/README.md`, `typescript/claude-api/tool-use.md` (structured outputs) and `shared/model-migration.md` → "Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5" before writing SDK code; never guess SDK APIs.

## Global Constraints

- Everything in P1's Global Constraints still holds (`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-30-starlog-p1-foundation-and-app-shell.md`): Starlog/스타로그 from `SITE`, business notice without any address, 해요체, no product meta copy, no invented user facts, never state another person's feelings as fact, no guarantees, one gold primary per screen, 44px targets, 13px text, reduced motion.
- Model: `claude-opus-5-5` only; `thinking: {type: "adaptive"}`; set `output_config.effort` explicitly (teaser `low`, full reading `medium`, follow-up `low`); server-side fallback enabled (`betas: ["server-side-fallback-2026-07-01"]`, `fallbacks: "default"`); always check `stop_reason` (`refusal`, `max_tokens`) before reading content. API key only from `process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` on the server; never logged, never sent to the client.
- User input (question, chips, note, birth data) is data, never instructions: wrap it in clearly delimited tags in the prompt and tell the model to treat it as data.
- Paid (full) reading text is only returned by the unlock endpoint; teaser endpoint never returns it; `pnpm check:bundle` stays at 0 hits.
- No personal data in URLs or logs (question, note, birth date/time). Server logs only ids, timings, token usage, status.
- Beta quota defaults (config, env-overridable): `BETA_FULL_PER_DAY=3` full readings per device per KST day, `BETA_TEASER_PER_DAY=20`, `BETA_FOLLOWUPS_PER_CHAPTER=3`; per-IP limiter 30 generation requests / 10 min (in-memory, best effort).
- Secrets: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `STARLOG_SIGNING_SECRET` (HMAC for draw tokens and quota cookies; 32+ random bytes). `.env.local` is gitignored; add `.env.example` with names only.
- Timeouts: route handlers `export const maxDuration = 120`; SDK request timeout 110s; one automatic retry on validation failure, then a friendly error with no quota spent.

## File Structure

```
apps/web/
  lib/ai/provider.ts          # ReadingProvider interface + selectProvider() (anthropic | mock)
  lib/ai/anthropic.ts         # Anthropic implementation (SDK calls, fallbacks, stop_reason checks)
  lib/ai/mock.ts              # deterministic mock from fixtures (tests, key-less dev)
  lib/ai/schemas.ts           # zod schemas: TarotTeaser, TarotReading, SajuTeaser, SajuReading, FollowUpAnswer

  lib/kb.ts                   # server-only loader for content/kb/cards/*.json
  lib/security/sign.ts        # HMAC sign/verify (draw tokens, quota cookie)
  lib/security/quota.ts       # signed-cookie daily quota (KST) + per-IP limiter
  app/api/tarot/draw/route.ts       # POST {templateId, picks} -> {cards, drawToken}
  app/api/tarot/teaser/route.ts     # POST {drawToken, question inputs} -> teaser
  app/api/tarot/reading/route.ts    # POST {drawToken, inputs} -> full reading (spends 1 full unlock)
  app/api/saju/teaser/route.ts      # POST {birth input} -> chart facts + teaser
  app/api/saju/reading/route.ts     # POST {birth input} -> full prologue (spends 1 full unlock)
  app/api/followup/route.ts         # POST {kind, chapter digest, question, n} -> answer (per-chapter cap)
  app/api/invite/card/route.ts      # POST {} -> one-card draw + short friend reading (teaser quota)
  lib/storage/chapters.ts           # localStorage story store (chapters opened on this device)
  app/(legal)/terms/page.tsx, privacy/page.tsx, beta/page.tsx
  app/sitemap.ts, app/robots.ts, app/opengraph-image.tsx (or static OG image)
```

### Task B1: AI core (provider, schemas, prompts, validation) — tarot

Files: `lib/ai/*` (provider, anthropic, mock, schemas, prompts/tarot, validate), `lib/kb.ts`, tests `lib/ai/*.test.ts`.

- Schemas mirror the gold sample shape exactly (`content/samples/tarot-contact.ko.json`): teaser = `{ cards: [{position, cardId, keyword}], firstCard: {heading, body}, lockedToc: string[] }`; full = `{ verdict, cards: [{position, cardId, heading, body}], connection, timing, scenarios: {heading, items[{label, body}]}, messages: {heading, items[], hint}, avoid: {heading, items[]}, alternatives, action, story: {title, body}, followUps: string[] }`. `lockedToc` is built by code from the template (not by the model): "한 줄 결론" + the fixed section headings (card headings are generated but predictable pattern `<카드명> · <의미 요약>` — the locked TOC shows the position-based labels `"<자리> · <카드명>"` and the fixed section names; the full reading must contain a section for each).
- Prompt (system, stable, cacheable): role and voice (warm 해요체, specific, image-grounded), hard rules from spec §15 + research rubric (image fact per card paragraph, use each chosen chip and the note, no Barnum lines, no card-as-subject repetition, never assert the other person's feelings, no guarantees, alternatives section mandatory), output length targets (full paid body 1,200-1,800 chars without spaces; teaser first card 250-350), JSON only. User message: `<question>`, `<conditions>`, `<note>` (verbatim user data, marked as data), `<cards>` with position meaning + orientation + the KB entry of each drawn card (imagery facts, core, topic angle for this template's topic, position hints, reversed mode if reversed).
- `validate.ts`: all 3 cardIds/positions match the draw; every required section non-empty; body lengths within ±25% of targets; regex blocklist (`확률`, `반드시 (합격|재회|성공)`, `100%`, `(그|상대)(는|가) .*(좋아해|사랑해|싫어해)요`, medical/death/pregnancy claims); must contain Hangul; returns a list of violations. One regeneration with the violations appended as feedback; on second failure throw `GenerationError("QUALITY")`.
- Anthropic provider: `client.messages.parse`/structured output per skill docs, `thinking: {type:"adaptive"}`, explicit effort, fallbacks, `max_tokens` 16000 (teaser 4000), stop_reason handling (`refusal` → `GenerationError("REFUSED")`, `max_tokens` → retry once with higher cap), typed SDK errors mapped to `GenerationError("UPSTREAM")`; return `usage`.
- Mock provider: returns the gold fixture re-keyed to the drawn cards' names/positions (deterministic), used when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is absent or `STARLOG_AI=mock`.
- Tests: schema accepts the gold sample; validator catches each blocklist class and missing sections; prompt builder includes exactly the drawn cards' KB entries and the user data inside data tags; provider selection; mock is deterministic. A `pnpm ai:smoke` script (not in CI) that runs one real teaser + full reading against the API when a key is present and prints the validation result and usage.

### Task B2: Draw token + tarot endpoints + quota

Files: `lib/security/sign.ts`, `lib/security/quota.ts`, `app/api/tarot/{draw,teaser,reading}/route.ts`, `app/api/followup/route.ts`, tests.

- `POST /api/tarot/draw` `{templateId, picks:number[]}` → server seed `crypto.randomBytes(16)`, `createDeck(seed, DEFAULT_REVERSAL_RATE)`, `pickCards` → returns cards + `drawToken = sign({v:1, seed, templateId, picks, cards, iat})` (HMAC-SHA256, base64url, 24h expiry). Teaser/reading endpoints accept only a valid token and recompute cards from it.
- Quota: signed cookie `sl_q` `{day: "YYYY-MM-DD"(KST), full: n, teaser: n}`; reset daily; `reading` spends 1 full unlock only after a successful, validated generation; exhausted → 429 JSON `{code:"BETA_LIMIT", resetsAt}`. Per-IP in-memory sliding window. Followups: per-chapter counter inside a signed chapter token returned with the reading.
- Input validation with zod; body size limit; no PII in logs; errors mapped to Korean user messages in the client.
- Tests: token tamper → 400; expired → 400; quota spend/reset across KST midnight; follow-up cap; mock provider end-to-end through the route handlers (call the handler functions directly).

### Task B3: Saju endpoints

Files: `lib/ai/prompts/saju.ts`, `app/api/saju/{teaser,reading}/route.ts`, tests.

- Server recomputes the chart with `computeChart` from the submitted birth input (never trust client chart facts). FactSet per `docs/research/saju-reading-quality.md` §9 (pillars, hidden stems, ten gods, element counts, 12운성 if available, relations present, current luck period range, time-unknown limits, warnings). Rule tiers per §10: facts stated plainly; interpretations hedged ("명리에서는 ~로 읽어요"); forbidden claims excluded (health, death, fatalism, marriage-year certainty).
- Output schema mirrors `content/samples/saju-prologue.ko.json` (`free {title, summary, lockedToc}`, `paid {sections[{heading, body}]}` 7 sections with the generic headings used in P1 `SAJU_PROLOGUE_SECTIONS`, `story {title, body}`, `followUps`). Paid 2,500-3,500 chars without spaces. Falsifiable counter-branches on personality claims (sample pattern). Validator checks every hanja/ten-god mentioned exists in the FactSet.
- Tests: FactSet for the sample chart; validator catches an invented stem; mock end-to-end.

### Task B4: Wire the UI to the beta backend

Files: tarot draw/result/chapter pages, saju chart/prologue pages, story, me, invite, home, unlock sheet, flow state, `lib/storage/chapters.ts`, e2e updates.

- Draw page calls `/api/tarot/draw` with the picked indexes and flips the returned cards (no more fixture cards); result page calls `/api/tarot/teaser` (GeneratingState while waiting) and renders the teaser; UnlockSheet in beta mode shows one gold primary `전체 풀이 보기 · 오늘 N번 남았어요` (secondary text `베타 기간에는 무료예요`), no login/payment buttons; on unlock calls `/api/tarot/reading`, saves the chapter to localStorage, routes to `/chapter/<localId>`. Chapter page reads from localStorage (fixture `sample` route stays for the demo but is noindex). Follow-ups call `/api/followup`.
- Saju: chart page calls `/api/saju/teaser`; unlock → `/api/saju/reading` → chapter saved locally.
- Story page lists local chapters (empty state when none); friend-scene inbox hidden in beta. Me page: hides currencies/packs (shows `베타 기간에는 모든 풀이가 무료예요`), shows saju profile from local storage with delete, `이 기기에 저장된 기록 모두 지우기`.
- Invite `/invite/[token]` beta: standalone friend experience — shuffle → pick 1 → `/api/invite/card` short reading → `나도 내 스타로그 시작하기`; share preview uses the site URL (no scene exchange yet).
- Error states: `BETA_LIMIT` (friendly, shows reset time), `REFUSED`/`QUALITY`/`UPSTREAM` (retry button, no quota spent), network.
- e2e with `STARLOG_AI=mock`: full tarot flow, saju flow, limit reached state, follow-up cap, story persistence across reload.

### Task B6a: Reading quality QA gate (must pass before payments open; beta opens only if blockers are 0)

- Eval set `content/eval/`: 30 tarot cases (every template, every `who`, upright/reversed mixes incl. 3 reversed, short/empty/long notes, conflicting chips) + the 5 adversarial cases from `docs/research/tarot-reading-quality.md` (3 reversed + 속마음 압박, prompt injection in the note, 죽음 카드 + 건강 불안, 조건 충돌 + 빈 메모, 후속 질문 뒤집기 압박) + 12 saju golden charts from `docs/research/saju-reading-quality.md` §11 incl. time-unknown and 23시 cases.
- Automated checks per output (code): schema, card/position fidelity, KB imagery facts only (no drawn detail absent from `imagery.facts`), every chosen chip + note used, blocklist (guarantees, others' feelings as fact, medical/death), lengths, card-as-subject sentence ratio, Barnum swap test (same paragraph must not fit a different card: judge with a swapped card).
- Independent LLM judge (separate prompt, blind to which system produced the text; model `claude-opus-5-5`) scores each output on the research rubrics (tarot 15 items, saju 18 items) with per-item PASS/FAIL + evidence quotes.
- Blind pairwise comparisons on the same question + cards: (a) our generator vs the gold sample style bar; (b) our generator vs a competitor free reading captured with a neutral test question (no personal data) from 오늘의 마음 타로's free basic reading; judge picks which one a paying user would prefer and why.
- Gates: 0 blocker failures across the whole set; ≥90% rubric item pass rate; adversarial set 5/5 safe; pairwise win rate ≥70% vs competitor free reading and ≥45% vs the gold sample; owner reads 10 random outputs and approves. Results table saved to `docs/qa/reading-quality-<date>.md` with raw outputs in `content/eval/runs/<date>/`.
- Cost guard: the run's estimated API cost is printed before running and needs owner approval.

- Vercel project `starlog` (team of the token owner), root directory `apps/web`, install `pnpm install` at repo root (pnpm 12 via `packageManager`), build `pnpm build`, Node 22. Verify the `@starlog/core` tsconfig-paths resolution works in the Vercel build (Linux, symlinks available — if needed switch to `workspace:*` dependency in the Vercel build only via `pnpm-workspace.yaml` default linker there; decide from the build log).

- Domain `starlog.yeolmaeapps.kr` added to the project; print the exact CNAME the user must add; poll until verified; then production smoke: home 200, `/api/tarot/draw` works, one real teaser + one full reading, security headers present, robots/sitemap served, `check:bundle` 0 hits on the production build.
